newsitem.title: UK: UK housing starts rise 15 pct in 3 mths to Nov.
newsitem.headline: UK housing starts rise 15 pct in 3 mths to Nov.

text.p: UK housing starts rose 15 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in the three months to November from the previous three, while total completions were up 1.0 percent, the Department of the Environment said on Thursday.
In the latest three months, a total of 47,300 dwellings were started, up 29 percent on the same three months a year ago. Completions totalled 46,300 and were down two percent from a year ago.
Private enterprise housing starts were up 16 percent and completions were up by 3.0 percent.
Housing association starts of new dwellings were higher than during the previous three months, but completions were lower.
Both starts and completions by local authorities and government departments remained at a low levels, the DOE said.
